source.name: Tour de France Femmes avec Zwift 2026 — EF Education-Oatly team profile (A.S.O.)
source.quote: Oatly, an oat drink producer, became the new co-sponsor of the American team in 2025, alongside the language training company EF Education.
source.note: Official race-organiser profile for the 2026 edition; the page is undated. The team carries its title sponsors' names on the jersey front; placement mapped from the team title/name per the league note.

source.name: EF Pro Cycling — Oatly and EF Pro Cycling announce new partnership
source.quote: Oatly’s logo will now appear on team uniforms worn while racing and training, and across several EF Pro Cycling properties
source.note: The same release says Oatly becomes 'an official co-title sponsor of our women's squad'. Co-title sponsors mapped to the jersey front per the league note; logo on the 2026 jersey visible in the team's 2026 roster photo.

source.name: EF Pro Cycling — Meet EF Pro Cycling's 2026 roster
source.quote: EF Education-Oatly general manager Esra Tromp
source.note: EasyPost logo on the upper chest of the pink 2026 jersey and the white world-champion jersey, read from the team photo on this page (26-01-02_meet-ef-pro-cycling-s-2026-roster_racing-1.jpg).

source.name: EF Pro Cycling — Meet EF Pro Cycling's 2026 roster
source.quote: our men’s, women’s and development squads are set to rocket past all expectations
source.note: Wahoo logo next to EasyPost on the upper chest of the 2026 jersey, read from the team photo on this page.

source.name: EF Pro Cycling — Meet EF Pro Cycling's 2026 roster
source.quote: Bike racing’s brightest prospects join team’s stars for 2026
source.note: Cannondale wordmark under the UCI badge on the chest of the 2026 jersey; the pink bikes in the same team photo also carry Cannondale marks. Both read from the team photo on this page.

source.name: EF Pro Cycling — Meet EF Pro Cycling's 2026 roster

source.note: CADILLAC wordmark and round crest on the upper sleeve of the 2026 jersey (visible on the pink women's jersey and the white world-champion jersey), read from the team photo on this page.

source.name: EF Pro Cycling — Meet EF Pro Cycling's 2026 roster
source.note: ASSOS star logo at the collarbone of the 2026 jersey, read from the team photo on this page. ASSOS is the team's kit supplier from 2026 (Cyclingnews, 2026-01-01: https://www.cyclingnews.com/pro-cycling/teams-riders/pushing-boundaries-together-ef-education-easypost-and-ef-education-oatly-partners-with-new-kitmaker-assos-following-split-with-rapha/).

source.quote: EF Education-Oatly’s squad for the Ardennes classics will be just as strong
source.note: STIFEL wordmark running vertically down the sleeve of the 2026 jersey, read from the team photo on this page.

source.name: EF Pro Cycling — Meet EF Pro Cycling's 2026 roster
source.quote: this year’s grand tours and classics are going to be scintillating
source.note: poc wordmark on the upper chest just below the collar of the 2026 jersey (visible on the pink women's jersey and the white world-champion jersey), read from the team photo on this page.

summary: 2026 UCI Women's WorldTeam in its first Assos-made kit: co-title sponsors EF Education First and Oatly on the front, with EasyPost, Wahoo, Cannondale, Assos and POC on the chest and Stifel and Cadillac on the sleeves — placements read from the team's 2026 roster photo. Back, shorts and any further placements not yet checked.
